biotools.summary: FUSE-PhyloTree is a phylogenomic analysis software that identifies local sequence conservation associated with the different functions of a protein family. The software combines advanced sequence analysis with phylogenetic methods to annotate gene trees with predicted sequence modules and ancestral gene functions.
